title: A round's acceptance list
description: What the owner asked for in one round, item by item, each with the command whose exit code proves it. Written with the settled spec, signed off by the owner before round-build starts; after that an agent may change `passes` and nothing else (scripts/round/acceptance.ts --against checks it). Lives beside the spec in Resonance-notes/<date>-roundNN/acceptance.json.

spec.description: The settled spec's path, in Resonance-notes (never under /tmp or /private/tmp: a session scratchpad is not kept).

signedOff.description: The owner's go-ahead, quoted: null until the owner has said go. round-build refuses a list without it.

id.description: r<round>-<n or slug>, unique in the list.

ask.description: The owner's words for this item, verbatim (Traditional Chinese as dictated).

section.description: Optional: the spec section that settles it (e.g. "§A").

verify.description: For each of the item's lanes, one shell command run from the worktree's root; exit code 0 proves the item on that lane. Every lane in `lanes` has one, and no other lane.

passes.description: Starts false. Set by `acceptance --run --write` on the merged base: true when every lane's command exited 0. The only field an agent may change.
